title: Grammar: Articles — A/An, The, and Zero Article
grammarTip:
Артикли — самая сложная тема в английском для русских и казахских студентов.

Основное правило:
a/an → первое упоминание / неопределённый предмет
the → конкретный известный предмет / второе упоминание
∅ (нет артикля) → имена собственные, языки, страны, учебные предметы

THE — когда оба говорящих знают о чём речь:
"Can you close the window?" (есть одно конкретное окно)
"I talked to the professor." (тот самый профессор)
"the sun, the moon, the Earth" (единственные в своём роде)

A/AN — неизвестный предмет или один из многих:
"She is a teacher." · "I need a pen." · "He has an idea."

НЕТ АРТИКЛЯ → абстрактные понятия и имена собственные:
"I study English." · "She loves music." · "He lives in Kazakhstan."

grammarTable.subject: A / An
grammarTable.short: one of many; first mention; job/role
grammarTable.example: She is a teacher. I saw a film. He found an opportunity.

grammarTable.subject: The
grammarTable.short: specific; second mention; unique; shared knowledge
grammarTable.example: The teacher is kind. The sun rises. Turn off the light.

grammarTable.subject: Zero article
grammarTable.short: general plural; uncountable; abstract; proper nouns
grammarTable.example: Dogs are friendly. Poverty is a problem. She studies medicine.

grammarTable.subject: The + adj.
grammarTable.example: The poor, the elderly, the homeless, the unemployed.

grammarTable.subject: A/An + role
grammarTable.example: He is a doctor. She became an activist. They elected a president.

grammarTable.subject: The + superlative
grammarTable.example: The most serious problem. The best solution. The highest rate.

rows.form: First mention: a/an (listener doesn't know which one)
rows.example: "There is a protest outside." (Which protest? A new one, unknown.)

rows.form: Second mention: the (listener now knows which one)
rows.example: "The protest was peaceful." (We know which one now.)
"The government announced new policy." (Both speakers know which government.)

rows.form: Zero article + plural noun = general statement about all
rows.example: "Dogs are loyal." "Politicians often make promises." "Students need support."

rows.form: The + singular noun = the species/category as a concept
rows.example: "The dog was first domesticated 15,000 years ago." (= dogs as a species)

rows.form: A/An + singular noun = any one example of the category
rows.example: "A student who works hard is more likely to succeed." (= any such student)

grammarExtra.title: The + Adjective = A Group of People

rows.example: "The poor need support." "The elderly deserve respect." "The homeless face serious health risks."

rows.form: These phrases are always plural in meaning
rows.example: "The unemployed are struggling." ✅ "The unemployed is struggling." ❌
"The rich should pay more. The disadvantaged need greater support."
"Education is important. Justice must be served. Freedom matters."
"Poverty is increasing. Housing is expensive. Inequality is harmful."
"at school, in hospital, at work, by car, at home, go to university"
"She lives in London. He visited France. They study at Oxford."
✅ Education is important. (general concept, zero article)
✅ I saw the most interesting film. (superlative always uses "the")

rows.form: ❌ The poverty is a growing problem.
rows.example: ✅ Poverty is a growing problem. (abstract noun: zero article)

exercises.hint: Abstract noun used generally: zero article

exercises.text: "She is ___ activist who campaigns for equality."
exercises.hint: "An" before vowel sound; first mention; job/role

exercises.instruction: Insert the correct article or write X for zero article.
exercises.text: "___ poor deserve more support from ___ government."
exercises.hint: "The poor" = group; "the government" = specific, known institution

exercises.text: "There is ___ problem with the current system."
exercises.hint: First mention; one of many possible problems

exercises.text: "___ homelessness is ___ public health crisis that affects every city."

opts: The education is free in this country.
The unemployment rate has risen sharply.
exercises.correct: The unemployment rate has risen sharply.
exercises.hint: "The unemployment rate" = specific rate we are discussing

exercises.text: "It is ___ most serious issue facing ___ society today."
"___ dogs make good companions" (general statement about all dogs)

exercises.hint: "A job" = one job; "the public sector" = known sector
"The + adjective" = group of people; always plural verb

exercises.text: "She goes to ___ university and works part-time at ___ local café."
exercises.hint: "Go to university" = fixed phrase, no article; "a local café" = first mention

opts: The poverty is a growing problem.
exercises.hint: "Poverty" (abstract, general) = zero; "a growing problem" = first mention

exercises.text: "___ government needs to invest in ___ affordable housing."
exercises.hint: "The government" = specific known institution; "affordable housing" = general concept

exercises.text: "___ sun provides energy for all life on Earth."
exercises.hint: "The sun" = unique, only one in our solar system

exercises.text: "She works as ___ social worker in ___ city centre."
exercises.hint: "A social worker" = job/role; "the city centre" = specific place

exercises.instruction: Which is the correct general statement?
exercises.hint: Abstract noun used generally: zero article

questions.text: "___ homeless often lack access to healthcare." Choose the correct article.
"She became ___ politician at the age of thirty."
"___ poverty is increasing rapidly in many regions." (Abstract noun, general)
questions.hint: Abstract noun used generally = zero article

questions.text: "It is ___ most unequal society in the developed world."
Which correctly uses "the" for shared knowledge?
questions.hint: "The president" = we both know which president is meant

questions.text: "The elderly are often overlooked" — this is grammatically correct.

questions.hint: "Study law / go to university" = fixed expressions, zero article

questions.text: "There was ___ protest in the city yesterday." (First mention)
questions.hint: First mention, one of many = a/an

questions.text: "___ inequality is difficult to measure, but ___ gap between rich and poor is widening."
questions.hint: Inequality (general): zero; "the gap" = specific gap we're talking about

questions.text: "___ internet has changed how people communicate." Choose the article.
"She found ___ accommodation in ___ city centre near her office."
